title.narrative: Building Tiny Houses and providing psychological first aid for vulnerable people in Mykolaiv region.

description.narrative: The purpose of this intervention is to strengthen vulnerable families and communities by improving their living conditions and providing psychological first aid. We have three main activities: 1) To provide 17 vulnerable families in Mykolaiv region with a Tiny House - fully functioning and equipped for 4 people. 2) To build up our partner's and their network's capacity by providing psychological first aid ToT-training courses for 220 people from our partner, their volunteers, and pastors/church leaders from different denominations, and community leaders near our target group. 3) To extend psychological first aid support to, firstly, the current target group and later to previous target groups. Expected outcomes for the intervention are improved security and living conditions of vulnerable people and families. Improved capacity and mental resilience of our Ukrainian partner and their associates. Improved mental resilience of vulnerable people and families and their communities.
